name: Nagoya Castle (Hizen)
description: Hizen Nagoya Castle was Hideyoshi's 1592 invasion base for the Korean campaigns, once Japan's largest castle with an adjacent camp of daimyo quarters. The reconstructed main gate, stone walls and the Korean War museum mark the site.
notes: The Nagoya Castle museum (名護屋城博物館) entrance is free; special exhibitions are paid. The castle site itself is open.
